rule: Per side in each race: (a) the ad with the most reported spending or airings when coverage names one; otherwise (b) the campaign's most recent general-election ad and the largest allied outside group's most recent ad, counting Senate Leadership Fund and One Nation as one group; (c) when that ad's wording was never published, the most recent one with published wording that states at least one of its claims. Party-committee ads go under the national Senate and House entries, except joint ads run with a candidate (the NRSC's for Sununu). State-specific super PAC ads go under their state.
